title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation), which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher-student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD

translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型生成的轨迹上提供教师监督，但单一轨迹在每个决策点只能实现一种延续，这在有限采样预算下限制了监督的覆盖范围。我们提出了BranchOPD（分支在线策略蒸馏），它利用学生不确定性和师生分歧来选择信息丰富的决策点，从共享前缀重新采样学生策略的延续，并对主轨迹和分支同时施加token级别的教师监督。BranchOPD在数学任务中作用于token级别的决策，在智能体任务中作用于回合内的决策。与七条独立轨迹相比，共享前缀复用在ALFWorld上降低了约19%、在WebShop上降低了约31%的学生生成token成本。我们还引入了协议边界修复（PBR）方法，它在协议约束下使用针对性监督来缓解重复生成和无效生成的问题。
tldr: BranchOPD通过学生不确定性和师生分歧选择信息丰富的决策点进行分支重采样，对主轨迹和分支同时施加token级教师监督，并借助共享前缀复用将生成token成本降低约19%-31%。
